Slot 17.256 x 32.376 holds 363 um2 of core vs 482 um2 recipe-2 content (input hold + output min delay cells a bit) -> depth grown to 17.28 x 99.36 (data-pin coordinates unchanged). | f6 face-cut sizing (verdict 17:32 GRT-0116 on the 513-b f5 pilots): data face grown to the pin demand at cut <= 0.6 -> 17.28 x 99.36; pins spread evenly per face (spread_face_pins.py: N/S M3/M5 alternation, W/E M4, clock at face centre); the die adopts this footprint + pin file (slot_change_request) | f8: no recipe-2 output hold pads (the vertical f6/f7 GRT-0116 overflow sat in the output hold-pad band behind the N-face dq pins); hop hold is carried by the receiver's input hold stages | f9 (S-NET+FILL 0600, first hardening of the horizontal 566 standard, DEDUPE S81-STN standard 566 per side): the same recipe as the CLOSED dsfd_stnv_566x1 f9 (cb219000e): no output hold pads, input hold stages, pin flops at the pins, depth from the flop content at util 0.45 (17.28), forwarded clock fi0 / fo0 at the centre of the W / E faces; c26b places 1,779 dsfd_stnh_566x1 with NO view (plus 538/512/514 x1 = 1,200 that DEDUPE rounds up to 566)
